name: ville-du-bien-etre
description: 🏙️ Wellbeing city builder — timed real-life activities earn coins to grow an isometric town. Focus & free modes, smart random draw, routines, weekly goals. 100% local, offline PWA, French UI. Vanilla JS, no framework.

paragraphs: Grow a city by taking care of yourself. Real-life activities with a timer earn coins, and coins build a living isometric town: it follows the time of day and the seasons, its residents stroll around and visitors drop by.
▶ Try it live — nothing to install, no account. In English or French.

100 % local — your city stays on your device (browser storage). Installable on iPhone and Android, works offline. Made to be shared with friends: everyone keeps their own city, and visits the others' with a simple link.
features: 🔥 Streak: +10 % per active day, up to +50 %; rest days (2 per week by default) and pauses keep it going
🌅 Welcome back: +20 % on the first session that starts a new streak, after at least 2 days without one
🎲 Draw: first draw accepted +20 % (wish) or +50 % (chore) from 3 available ideas, halved on each paid re-roll
🗓️ Challenges: 5 M per challenge completed, up to 15 M a week
